statements.statement: CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered for the patient
The patient had recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms were suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient had sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
The patient had a documented personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to detect arrhythmic events and guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate-control management
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
SilverBridge Advantage requires all such diagnostic monitoring services to be pre-approved
